rule: Three rules carry the feel. (A) Per-player, per-faction standing on a clamped scale, moved one step per kill of a member: friends turn colder, enemies warmer, and the examine line shows one standing word from fixed bands. (B) Keep control as a world event: each capture, claim, raze or release is one server-wide line, and the level clock is meant to depend on relics held (design comment only, currently returns zero). (C) Names that carry place and role: guards named by role, realm and zone, and realm rank titles indexed by realm level divided by ten, gender and realm.
keep: standing word on examine, banded from a clamped value
one step per member kill, friends colder and enemies warmer
one server-wide broadcast line per keep event
guard names that carry role, realm and zone
realm rank titles by realm level divided by ten
zone as one data row with box, flags and reward fields
change: send the relationship message only when the stored value changes
name the 20 percent gate as a designer dial or remove it
implement the relic-count keep upgrade table as data and re-arm the timer per level step
zone realm and faction seeds set per zone (donor seeds all to zero)
standing computed and kept on the server; client shows the word only
look_test: One Pit zone flag with a rival-faction guard. Show the examine word moving friendly to neutral to hostile over three, six and nine kills, and one broadcast line on a test keep change. Compare the single word against a three-step bar with the same word, on a 375-wide phone.
